results.suite: Suite 5: Adversarial Review & Bug Detection
results.name: CHALLENGE: Switching to MIDI mode cleanly terminates the physical microphone stream and pauses audio loop
results.details: BUG FOUND: setMode("midi") leaves AudioContext and requestAnimationFrame(loop) running. Real mic loop continues capturing and overriding pitch state while in MIDI mode.
results.challengeNote: HIGH: Audio stream leak and mode state collision. The microphone stream continues processing input during MIDI mode because loop() lacks a mode guard and setMode does not stop the microphone.

results.suite: Suite 5: Adversarial Review & Bug Detection
results.name: CHALLENGE: Headless test triggers (0¢, -18¢, +24¢) latch state without immediate overwrite by drift loop or mic
results.details: FAILURE: triggerSimulationCents sets state but does NOT pause the 50ms drift interval or real mic loop. The simulated drift or real mic overwrites triggered values in 50ms - 500ms.
results.challengeNote: HIGH: Test flakiness risk in Playwright E2E. Automated assertions must assert immediately before the 50ms drift interval or ambient audio frame fires.
